run_generate_colorization_bins_priors: run the script to generate color bins and priors for colorization model training
run_compute_color_bins_frequency: run compute_color_bins_frequency to compute histogram-based color bin frequencies from an image dataset
run_generate_prior_hull_files: run generate_prior_hull_files to save color bin hull points and prior probabilities as numpy files
test_convert2lab: test the convert2lab function that converts a BGR uint8 image to normalized LAB color space
test_HWC2CHW: test the HWC2CHW function that transposes image arrays from HWC to CHW format
